text:
leo: Quick proposal — add optional client-side batching in the SDKs to reduce per-request overhead and improve throughput. Server will accept a lightweight batch hint header and expand accounting on the backend.

emma: OK cool. must clarify quota semantics — we should still charge on tokens, not requests, but dashboard needs to show both tokens and batch counts.

raj: Header negotiation worries me. Older SDKs will send nothing. We should default to single-request semantics when header missing. Also prefer a namespaced header like `X-RW-Client-Batch` to avoid collisions.

sofia: Metrics: add `client.batch.size` and `client.batch.count` telemetry. Console should surface per-route batch throughput and per-token cost so customers can see unit economics.

matt: Are we planning to enable batching by default in any SDK? If default flips, that becomes a behavioral break (latency, quota burn patterns). I vote opt-in only for initial rollout.

leo: Agreed opt-in for now. Proposal: SDK exposes env var `RW_SDK_BATCHING=on` or an SDK config `batching.enabled: true`. Header example: 
```
X-RW-Client-Batch: count=8;mode=client
Authorization: Bearer ...
```
Server will parse `count` and attribute telemetry + billing to the originating request.

raj: From backend side we need a safe path for quota enforcement: if header present, validate that payload length matches `count` (or fallback to `count=1` if mismatch). Also tag traces with `origin:client-batch` so we can filter.

sofia: For console UX: add a toggle to view billing by "requests" vs "effective tokens"; and a separate chart for "batches per minute". We should also annotate rollout windows and canary flags.

leo: Rollout idea: canary 5% of SDK clients, then 25%, then 100. We'll gate server-side parsing behind a feature flag `client_batch_parsing` and route policy to fallback if parsing errors. Also create a migration doc and changelog.

emma: Add an eval suite to watch for quality regressions: run prompt set with and without batching to ensure no change in generation distribution. If regressions > threshold, auto-disable for that canary cohort.

matt: SDK work items: docs, opt-in API surface, tests for header encoding/decoding, and compatibility tests for older runtime. I'll open PRs for TS/py/go.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-1427 "client-side batching: header, telemetry, console metrics, rollout plan" assigned to @matt, priority P2 — https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-1427 :robot_face: 

raj: Also request: add `client.batch.sample_rate` metric to control telemetry volume. Keep distribution high enough to detect anomalies but low enough to limit costs.

sofia: DevEx note: will prep a short "how to enable client batching" doc + example snippets for Py/TS/Go and a console explainer for billing differences.

leo: Thanks — next steps: matt to draft PRs, raj/backend to add parsing behind flag, sofia/devex to draft docs, and emma to assemble the eval set. We’ll reconvene after first canary results. :thumbsup:
